SPECIAL SAVINGS CERTIFICATES
SPECIAL SAVINGS CERTIFICATES
RULES, 1990
(Amendment of R.4)
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part II,
13th August, 2011]
S.R.O.
762(I)/2011, dated 11-8-2011.---In exercise of the powers conferred by section
28 of the Public Debt Act, 1944 (XVIII of 1944), the Federal Government is
pleased to direct that the following further amendments shall be made in the
Special Savings Certificates Rules, 1990, the same having been previously
published vide Notification No. S.R.O. 592(I)/2011, dated the 8th June, 2011,
as required under subsection (1) of the said section, namely:--
In
the aforesaid Rules, in rule 4,-
(i) clause
(iv) shall be omitted; and
(ii) for
clause (v) the following shall be substituted, namely:--
"(v) all
institutional investment shall be discontinued with immediate effect.".
